title: Songs
summary: Learning songs written to order from the learner's words and sung by Suno, kept for good.
description: Songs get Polish stuck in the head. Each verse pairs an English line with the same line in Polish, and the chorus is one Polish sentence.

stories.as: a learner who remembers songs better than word lists
stories.want: a song written from my own words and sung

stories.as: a learner who liked a song
stories.soThat: it still plays offline when the service that made it has deleted it

requirements.text: A song is written from a theme, a vocabulary topic and, optionally, the exact chorus sentence.
The lyrics can be edited by hand, or revised by the songwriter, before anything is sung.
A song's length is short, medium or long (the default), each a lyric structure the songwriter follows.
Songs are sung by Suno through kie.ai with the learner's kie.ai key, in the model chosen in Settings: V6, V6 Mini or V6 Wild.
Each song comes in two takes.
Generation runs in the background and carries on after leaving the screen or restarting the app.
After a restart only the device that started a song resumes polling for it and downloading it; a device where the learner taps retry takes the song over.
Both takes and their cover art are downloaded and stored in the database, and play offline.
When a song is ready the app fetches Suno's word timings and stores them with each take.
A song remembers the course whose words it uses, and its listening lesson is filed there.
Enough of what a song was made from is kept to rebuild the prompt that made it.
Many songs can be deleted at once from the song list.
